title: Creator Lab / It pays to be you

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Use a short message and a distinct field to maintain recognition at architectural scale.
strategic_value: A purple surround and familiar glyph can connect Instagram’s creator message to a large city wall.
demonstration: A mural places a photograph inside a purple field, with dispersed pink words and you highlighted in a rounded block.
practical_value: Check the hierarchy of image, short copy and signature at the scale of a building.

content_islands.name: Purple mural field
content_islands.spec: Frame the central photograph with a broad purple surround and upper-right glyph.

content_islands.name: Creator message
content_islands.spec: Distribute the pink phrase around the photo and emphasize you in a rounded pink tile.

reference_purposes.Application: The image shows the identity applied as a large Creator Lab mural.
reference_purposes.Expression: Purple, pink and loose headline placement give the mural the system’s expressive voice.
